\---

applyTo: "resources/views/\*\*, reports/\*\*, pdf/\*\*"

\---



\## PDF instructions

\- Preserve existing PDF routes unless explicitly asked to replace them

\- Keep templates printable and deterministic

\- Prefer adding a new PDF path over breaking legacy PDF generation

\- If using evidence assets, handle missing files gracefully

\- Keep rendering logic separated from domain assembly logic
